description: This file defines the 'List' feature within the 'Articles' namespace of the application. It contains the 'Query' record for requesting a list of articles with filtering options, and the 'QueryHandler' class to process such requests, fetching data from the database context based on specified criteria, including support for personalized feeds, tags, authors, and favorites.

classes.name: List
classes.description: Contains the 'Query' record and the 'QueryHandler' class to handle article list requests and fetch data accordingly.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the 'Query' request to fetch a list of articles based on filtering criteria such as tag, author, favorited user, and whether it is a feed for the current user. Performs database queries, applies filters, and returns an 'ArticlesEnvelope' object containing the articles and total count.
